title: SECTIONOBJECT DXF name retained owner
mode: local fast implementation slice with generated controls
scope: Charge the AcDbSection DXF group-1 name to its parsed entity owner lease
Preserve replacement, copy/assignment, and reset accounting behavior
Distinguish aggregate input-record admission from field replacement reservation

implementation.summary: DRW_SectionObject::parseCode now passes the AcDbSection group-1 name through replaceDxfRetainedStringField with a dedicated byte counter. The explicit copy constructor and assignment preserve the count and shared entity lease; resetDwgState clears/releases it. Generated ASCII controls find the minimum accepted aggregate cap, verify exact-cap retention and final-owner lifetime, and check that one-byte-under admission stops before the new name is parsed while preserving the old name.
implementation.layoutChange: A private retained-byte counter was added to public DRW_SectionObject layout. Downstream consumers must rebuild; binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.

commands: git diff --check -- src/drw_entities.h src/drw_entities.cpp tests/hardening_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md

assessment.claim: The selected parser-owned SECTIONOBJECT group-1 name is charged to the shared logical retained-byte budget and its lease follows copies until final reset/destruction. The one-byte-under cap prevents the replacement record from being fully admitted and leaves the prior name intact; it does not prove the replacement helper itself was the first denied reservation. This does not bound capacity, RSS, public mutation, writer copies, or all object fields.
assessment.coverage: Generated ASCII direct-parser controls verify minimum-cap discovery, exact-cap success, one-byte-under no-replacement, copy construction/assignment, sibling reset, and final release. The owning hardening CTest passes.
assessment.limitations: No full OBJECTS callback stream, persistent/external drawing, peer parser, native CAD application, full suite, allocation benchmark, DWG byte-layout change, or support promotion was used.
